mapper.select: SELECT student_id FROM biz_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT la.lesson_id AS lessonId, la.theory_open AS theoryOpen FROM biz_lesson_assignment la JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id = la.lesson_id AND IFNULL(l.status, '0') = '0' WHERE la.dept_id = #{deptId} AND la.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND la.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY la.assign_time DESC, la.assignment_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(redo_id), 0) FROM biz_theory_redo_history WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(redo_id), 0) FROM biz_typing_redo_history WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_typing_redo_history (dept_id, lesson_id, student_id, entry_year, class_code, teacher_id, previous_revision, snapshot_json) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{lessonId}, #{studentId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{teacherId}, #{revision}, #{snapshot})
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(h.redo_id), 0) FROM biz_typing_redo_history h WHERE h.student_id = s.student_id AND h.lesson_id = #{lessonId}) AS typingRevision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student_answer a JOIN biz_lesson_question lq ON lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND lq.question_id = a.question_id JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id AND q.question_type = 'typing' WHERE a.student_id = s.student_id AND a.lesson_id = #{lessonId}) AS typingAnswerCount, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(h.redo_id), 0) FROM biz_theory_redo_history h WHERE h.student_id = s.student_id AND h.lesson_id = #{lessonId}) AS revision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student_answer a JOIN biz_lesson_question lq ON lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND lq.question_id = a.question_id JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id AND q.question_type IN ('choice', 'judgment') WHERE a.student_id = s.student_id AND a.lesson_id = #{lessonId}) AS answerCount FROM biz_student s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND s.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND s.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY s.student_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_theory_redo_history (dept_id, lesson_id, student_id, entry_year, class_code, teacher_id, previous_revision, snapshot_json) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{lessonId}, #{studentId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{teacherId}, #{revision}, #{snapshot})
